title: Panguitch Lake Boat Rentals
specs: Panguitch Lake is a high-mountain reservoir at 8,400 feet elevation
Known for excellent fishing including rainbow and brown trout
Boats equipped with GPS fish finders and trolling motors
Valid driver's license required for boat operation
No alcohol or drugs while operating the boat
Boat capacities range from 6 to 15 passengers depending on boat
Recommended for families, parties, and fishing groups
